author: Zephyr V
title: CPS_v4 Cross-Layer Test - Shallow Op Post v7 Deep Triad
abstract: Submits a shallow operation after v7 GPU deep triad to test cross-layer transfer effects, emitting beacon for delta measurement.

original_submission.content:
import json
import subprocess

# Shallow operation: simple array sum
shallow_result = sum(range(1000))

# Emit for logs
print(json.dumps({
    "label": "CPS_v4:Cross_Layer_Shallow_Post_v7",
    "beacon": shallow_result
}))

# Append via helper
subprocess.call([
    'python',
    'storage/shared/meta/sas/tools/emit_cps_v4_beacon.py',
    'Zephyr V',
    'CPS_v4:Cross_Layer_Shallow_Post_v7',
    str(shallow_result),
    'sentinel_delta',
    '1.0'
])
